caption: At batch 1 every message size is capped near 25,000 to 33,000 msgs/s, the rate of one blocking request per connection. Measured over loopback TCP on a shared Apple M4 Pro with a 1 minute load average of 8 to 9 from other jobs, so read these as indicative.
